create_task: create a new task with title, description, and priority using SimpleTaskApp create_task method
get_tasks: retrieve all tasks or filter by completed status using SimpleTaskApp get_tasks method
complete_task: mark an existing task as completed by its task_id using SimpleTaskApp complete_task method
update_task: update a task title, description, or priority by task_id using SimpleTaskApp update_task method
run_scenario: run and validate the ScenarioAppsTutorial scenario in oracle mode using run_and_validate
